newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel differentials ease late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel differentials ease late.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel differentials eased modestly and unleaded basis was largely unchanged in quiet discussion late on Monday, traders said.
Trade was thin as several major players were out of the market attending the National Petroleum Refiners Association conference in San Antonio, Texas.
Traders continued to look for Midwest spot prices to be steady to lower early in the week, with firming expected later in the week as traders returned from the annual industry conference.
"I really think the market is going to drift lower, and when (traders) come back from NPRA it's going to go higher. It always does," one trader said.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 4.25 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Group Three and 3.75 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago for prompt deliveries, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was talked 2.0 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 1.75 cents over in Chicago for all March timings, traders said.
